lessons.title: Question: Grid template value
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which values set the grid columns in the following code?

15px 16px17px 18px16px 17px

15px 16px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
You change the first column width to 20px and leave all other values unchanged. How much wider does it become?

5px wider.4px wider.3px wider.20px wider.

5px wider.

lessons.title: Question: Mix of units I
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which measurements can we combine to create rows and columns that adapt in size?

50% 50% / 50% 50%50% 50% / 10px 1fr50px 50px / 30px 30px

50% 50% / 50% 50%.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A two-by-two grid should keep every row and column at half of its container as the container resizes. Which track measurements do that?

50% 50% / 50% 50%50% 50% / 10px 1fr50px 50px / 30px 30px10px 1fr / 50% 50%

Make sure to pick 50% 50% / 50% 50%.

lessons.title: Question: Mix of units II
lessons.interactiveContent:
What property and value should we use to create the following grid?

grid-template: 1fr 1fr / 1fr 1fr 1frgrid-template: 50% 50% / 80px 10px 120pxgrid-template: 80px 120px 1fr / 1fr 1fr

grid-template: 1fr 1fr / 1fr 1fr 1fr.
lessons.hardModeContent:
What property and value should we use to create the following grid?

The preview has two equally flexible rows and three equally flexible columns. Which grid-template declaration produces that layout?

grid-template: 1fr 1fr / 1fr 1fr 1frgrid-template: 1fr 1fr 1fr / 1fr 1frgrid-template: 50% 50% / 80px 10px 120pxgrid-template: 80px 120px 1fr / 1fr 1fr

grid-template: 1fr 1fr / 1fr 1fr 1fr.

lessons.title: Example: Grid template
lessons.interactiveContent:
To create grid rows and columns in one line, code the grid-template property.

Make sure to pick grid, followed by -, and finally template.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use one declaration to create two rows of 70px each and two columns of 1fr each.

Make sure to pick grid-template, followed by 70px, and finally 70px.

lessons.title: Example: Mix of units II
lessons.interactiveContent:
Create a grid where the columns and rows get progressively smaller.

Make sure to pick 3fr followed by 2fr and then 1fr, /, 3fr, 2fr, 1fr.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Create a grid where the columns and rows get progressively smaller.

Make sure to pick 3fr, followed by 2fr, 1fr, /, 3fr, 2fr, and finally 1fr.

lessons.title: Example: Rows gaps
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set the row gaps in this grid to 5px.

Make sure to pick row-gap, followed by 5px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Set gaps only between rows to 5px. Leave the columns without gaps.

Make sure to pick row-gap, followed by 5px.

lessons.title: Question: Column gaps
lessons.interactiveContent:
Which gap property does the following grid have?

column-gaprow-gapmargin

Make sure to pick column-gap.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Which declaration adds 5px between columns while leaving the row gaps at zero?

column-gap: 5px;row-gap: 5px;gap: 5px;margin: 5px;

Make sure to pick column-gap: 5px;.

lessons.title: Question: Equal grid gaps
lessons.interactiveContent:
What property should we use to create the following grid gaps at the same time?

gaprow-gapcolumn-gap

Make sure to pick gap.
lessons.hardModeContent:
What property should we use to create the following grid gaps at the same time?

The preview needs matching 5px spaces between both rows and columns. Which single property controls both directions?

gaprow-gapcolumn-gapmargin

Make sure to pick gap.

lessons.title: Example: Gap shorthand
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the grid gap shorthand property and set its value to create bigger row gaps than column gaps.

Make sure to pick gap, followed by 10px, and finally 5px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use the gap shorthand so row gaps are twice as large as column gaps.

Make sure to pick gap, followed by 10px, and finally 5px.

lessons.title: Example: Equal grid gaps
lessons.interactiveContent:
Use the gap shorthand to create a visible gap between both rows and columns.

Make sure to pick gap, followed by 5px.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Use the gap shorthand to create a visible gap between both rows and columns.

Make sure to pick gap, followed by 5px.

lessons.title: Question: Grid row property
lessons.interactiveContent:
What happens when we use the grid-row property?

Grid items are spanned across grid rowsGrid items are spanned across grid columnsThe grid is spanned across the defined rows

Grid items are spanned across grid rows.
lessons.hardModeContent:
A card uses grid-row: span 1;. You change it to span 3 and keep its column rule unchanged. What changes?

The card covers three rows and keeps the same column span.The card covers three columns and keeps the same row span.Every card in the grid now covers three rows.The space between rows becomes three times larger.

The card covers three rows and keeps the same column span.

lessons.title: Example: Grid row value
lessons.interactiveContent:
Set grid-row to the value that spans a grid item across three grid rows.

Make sure to type span 3.

lessons.title: Question: Grid column value
lessons.interactiveContent:
What does this CSS rule do?

It spans a grid item across three grid columnsIt defines three columns for the grid containerIt spans a grid item across three grid rows

It spans a grid item across three grid columns.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Place .item in a grid with six columns. What footprint does this rule give the item?

The item occupies three adjacent grid columnsThe grid container is reduced to three columnsThe item occupies three adjacent grid rowsThe item starts at grid line three and occupies one column

The item occupies three adjacent grid columns.

lessons.title: Example: Grid column value
lessons.interactiveContent:
Code the value so that the grid item spans across two columns.

Make sure to pick span, followed by 2.
lessons.hardModeContent:
Code the value so that the grid item spans across two columns.

Write span before its count.

Make sure to pick span, followed by 2.

lessons.title: Question: Grid row value
lessons.interactiveContent:
What grid-row value does Item 2 have?

span 33span 1

span 3.
lessons.hardModeContent:
In the preview, Item 2 occupies the height of three grid rows. Which grid-row value creates that span?

span 33span 1span 2

Make sure to pick span 3.
